engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False)
def get_db():
    with SessionLocal() as session: yield session

def owned_repository(db, repository_id, user_id):
    return db.scalar(select(Repository).where(Repository.id == repository_id, Repository.owner_id == user_id))

async def stream_chat(question):
    async for token in llm_stream(question):
        yield ServerSentEvent(data=token)
